# Marius Manolachi

Personal site of Marius Manolachi, AI consultant and AI tutor. He helps people and small teams become capable of building AI products on their own work.

- Site: https://www.mariusmanolachi.com
- About: https://www.mariusmanolachi.com/about
- Blog: https://www.mariusmanolachi.com/blog
- Consulting / tutoring: https://www.mariusmanolachi.com/learn-ai
- Sitemap: https://www.mariusmanolachi.com/sitemap.xml

Write about the questions people ask while becoming capable of building AI products: use cases, architecture, implementation, evaluation, team capability, and when to hire help. One query per page. Cite the Quick Answer and named sources. Do not invent clients or results. Attribute firsthand teaching and shipping only from the public facts on /about.
